anchors.title: Cairns Esplanade Lagoon
anchors.description: Free 4,800m² saltwater swimming lagoon on the foreshore — sandy, lifeguard-supervised and croc-free. The 2.5km esplanade has free BBQs, playgrounds and a 35-station fitness circuit.

anchors.title: Great Barrier Reef Day Cruise
anchors.description: Multiple operators run daily catamarans from the Reef Fleet Terminal to the outer reef pontoons of Norman, Moore and Hastings. Snorkel, dive, and view from the glass-bottom boats. Includes all gear.

anchors.title: Skyrail Rainforest Cableway
anchors.description: 7.5km gondola flight above the canopy of the World Heritage Wet Tropics rainforest to Kuranda Village. Two boardwalk stations and a ranger-guided rainforest walk en route.

anchors.title: Kuranda Scenic Railway
anchors.description: 1891 mountain railway that climbs from Cairns through 15 hand-cut tunnels and over 37 bridges to the village of Kuranda. Pair with Skyrail for a one-way each direction.

anchors.title: Crystal Cascades Swimming Holes
anchors.description: 30 minutes from town in Lamb Range — a chain of freshwater swimming holes connected by an easy 1.2km path. Crocodile-free, with picnic tables at the entrance.

SATURDAY.title: Rusty's Markets
SATURDAY.description: Cairns' iconic tropical produce market, in continuous operation since 1975. Mangoes, mangosteens, dragon fruit, fresh juices and Asian street food. Friday-Sunday from 5am-6pm.

SUNDAY.title: Cairns Esplanade Markets
SUNDAY.description: Every Saturday on the Esplanade — 100+ stalls of art, jewellery, fresh juices and live buskers along the foreshore. 8am-4pm.
